title: LMHM2237 — Self-test mode entry (§6-3)
description: Humidity sensor and PCB thermistor self-diagnosis — F-1/F-2/F-4 or PASS.

source.manualTitle: LG LMHM2237BD Over-the-Range Microwave Service Manual

steps.title: Enter self-test mode
steps.body: Press Defrost weight/time for 2 seconds. Unit displays TEST and beeps once. The unit checks PCB humidity sensor and PCB thermistor for short or open. If faulted, unit beeps and displays F-1, F-2, or F-4. If normal, unit beeps and displays PASS. Press Clear to return to standby.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Defrost weight/time for 2 seconds , unit will display TEST
